hints.title: Consecutive Increasing Child Paths
hints.text: Track consecutive sequence length downward from parent to child, resetting to one if child value is not one greater than parent.

hints.title: Top-Down Length Passing
hints.text: Pass the current path length down to each child node, incrementing if child value is exactly parent value plus one.

hints.title: Recursive Downward Path Traversal
hints.text: Define dfs(node, parent, length). If node is null, return. If parent and node.val == parent.val + 1, length += 1; else length = 1. Update max_length with length. Recurse on left and right children.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Optimal linear traversal passing consecutive run lengths top-down.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Rechecking ancestor paths from each node takes quadratic O(N^2) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Passing parent value down during traversal tracks continuity in O(H) stack memory.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Paths must be parent-to-child in strictly consecutive increasing order.
